name: XTR I-spec EV right-hand shifter
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 117 g for the exact SL-M9100-IR I-spec EV right-hand control, selected for a 1x12 reference. The manufacturer also documents an 11/12-speed converter; no left control is presumed for the single-chainring assembly.
